title: Restore schema-v2 deployment validation compatibility
objective: Allow the strict deployment validator to accept the current schema-v2 data branch through an in-memory additive validation view without weakening schema-v3 or privacy checks.
forbidden_changes: Do not change schemas, scoring, collectors, frontend, workflows, credentials, or data files.
acceptance_criteria: Current origin/data schema-v2 payload validates through the release command.
Privacy checks still apply to v2.
